The CLV primitive operates under a probabilistic framework where expected lifetime value is computed through discounted future rewards weighted by outcome likelihood. Calibration ensures these values are reliable, using isotonic regression and Brier decomposition to assess trustworthiness. The Evidence Vault primitive enforces integrity through a confidence-based filtering mechanism, ensuring only high-assurance evidence enters the system. The Signal Ledger primitive governs how these elements interact through state transitions, modeling the evolution of beliefs from raw data to actionable insights. These primitives form a closed-loop system where each component validates and feeds into the next, creating a robust foundation for autonomous reasoning. Failure modes include calibration drift, evidence contamination, and state transition inconsistency. Dualities arise between probabilistic forecasting and deterministic validation, and between modular construction and holistic integration.
